title: Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning
description: First few-shot multimodal model. Perceiver resampler + cross-attention into frozen LLM. Few-shot visual QA, captioning, classification without fine-tuning. Defined vision-language pre-training at scale.
authors: Alayrac, Donahue, Luc, Miech, Barr, Hasson, Lenc, Mensch, Millican, et al.
